desc:
Update 10/17/2026
- Fixed when car plane and firework tool activated the one in your hand would not disappear.
- Added animations for all tools from the wonderful steamhappy shop on activate.
- Added animations idle and trigger for shotgun tool from the shop and golden steamhappy.
- Added drinking animation to the steamhappy potion that turns you into steamhappy.
- Fixed bug when you joined the game and were in menu screen and died the play button would disappear after you respawned.
- Added a cat on one of the shelves when clicked it will meow and break the shelf.
- Added when you punch steamhappy in steamhappy museum a tooth will fall out and steamhappy will go back to yellowish color when not punched anymore.
- Made when lava floor experiment is active in chomiks room it will make a sizzle sound and smoke will appear it also damages you now.

steamhappy experiment gmae
We love hurting steamhappy dont we

Inspired by nothing this game idea just popped on my head and made it real haha
